name: @touch/operator-shell
description: Electron shell for the Touch Padel operator app: SQLite durable queue, LAN KDS server, heartbeat, printing, kiosk.

scripts.dist: pnpm --filter @touch/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && node scripts/native-abi.mjs electron && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm --filter @touch/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && node scripts/native-abi.mjs electron && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @touch/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && node scripts/native-abi.mjs electron && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never

x-notes: CommonJS on purpose (no "type": "module"): Electron main/preload compile to CJS — the monorepo-wide ESM rule's one exception.
sharp is deliberately NOT installed: the print pipeline thresholds Chromium BGRA captures in plain JS (src/main/print/raster.ts).

electron-builder.config.cjs (JS, not YAML) so Windows signing is conditional on env: Azure Trusted Signing or a PFX, else unsigned. Publishes to the public KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases repo, which is also the electron-updater feed.

Auto-update: electron-updater downloads silently (checks at boot, then every 6h) and installs at the next start before the window opens when an earlier session left a newer download (waits up to 15 s for the check, 30 s on macOS; one try per version, written down before it is made; never on an install for all users, which would need a UAC answer, nor to a version the station has already run; userData/updater-startup.json), on the rail's Update ready control, or on the manager-PIN quit, which reopens the app. A Windows shutdown/restart does not install; the start after it does. No scheduled update windows (plan cut #7 stands).

better-sqlite3 is ONE hoisted binary (root node_modules, node-linker=hoisted) and Electron 33 (ABI 130) and Node 22 (ABI 127) cannot share it. electron-builder's rebuild never reaches it (npmRebuild: false, see the config). `pnpm dist` and the release workflow run scripts/native-abi.mjs electron, which fetches the Electron prebuild and proves it opens a database under electron.exe before packaging; scripts/before-pack.cjs then re-fetches it per packaged arch (the mac build ships arm64 and x64 from one runner). `pnpm native:node` flips it back so `pnpm test` (vitest under Node) passes again; expect ~47 shell tests to fail while the Electron build is in place.
